i: 已于9月底关门的韩国Cafe。日式早餐的寿司明显是外面买来的现成寿司，水准不如Sushi Hub。饮品较出色，抹茶草莓和抹茶咖啡都好喝。和Wahroonga的Sofé烘焙店同一个老板，Sofé要好很多。
de: Matcha strawberry, matcha coffee
ie: Korean café that closed at the end of September. The Japanese breakfast sushi was clearly pre-made and below Sushi Hub standard. Drinks were better: matcha strawberry and matcha coffee. Same owner as Sofé bakery in Wahroonga, which is much better.

i: Wentworth Point居民楼下的日料店，水准比位置给人的期待高。Salmon Tartare和牛排很出色；拉面汤底不是熬的，天妇罗略油，但都不影响整体。人均约50刀吃得饱。
de: Salmon tartare, steak
ie: Japanese restaurant under an apartment block in Wentworth Point, better than the location suggests. Salmon tartare and steak are excellent; the ramen broth is not house-made and tempura slightly oily, but no big deal. About $50 per person.

n: BananaLa 香蕉小馆（已由蓝曦食堂接手）
i: Rhodes居民区里的湘式小炒，现已由蓝曦食堂接手。炒鸡好吃够辣；生炒肥肠是白色的，很香；辣椒炒肉的瘦肉略柴；土匪猪肝一般。几道菜配炒米粉非常过瘾。人均约50刀。
de: Stir-fried chicken, fresh-fried intestine, fried rice vermicelli
ie: Hunan-style stir-fry in residential Rhodes, now taken over by Lanxi Kitchen. Stir-fried chicken was tasty and hot; the white fresh-fried intestine fragrant; chilli pork slightly dry; bandit liver average. With fried rice vermicelli it was very satisfying. About $50 per person.

d: 草莓鹅肝、Kingfish刺身、烤大虾、鸭腿、牛排（39刀）、桌前火焰可丽饼
i: 很有氛围的法餐厅。前菜草莓鹅肝、Kingfish刺身和Beef Tartare都好，草莓的酸甜正好化解鹅肝的腻。主菜烤大虾、鸭腿和牛排都很出色，牛排只要39刀，非常划算。甜品是桌边现场制作的火焰可丽饼，很有仪式感。适合约会和姐妹聚会，人均约100刀。
de: Strawberry foie gras, kingfish crudo, grilled prawns, duck leg, $39 steak, tableside flambé crêpes
ie: Atmospheric French restaurant. Strawberry foie gras, kingfish crudo and beef tartare are good; the strawberry cuts the richness of the foie gras. Grilled prawns, duck leg and steak mains are excellent, the steak only $39. Dessert is crêpes flambéed at the table, a real occasion. Great for dates and friends, about $100 per person.

i: Chatswood原大东北位置的自助火锅，每人二十多刀，非常便宜。肉、鱼、丸子、蔬菜和熟食一应俱全，能吃饱，但味道一般。
de: Meat, fish, balls, vegetables, hot food
ie: All-you-can-eat hotpot in Chatswood's old Da Dong Bei spot, just over $20 per person. Meat, fish, balls, vegetables and hot food, enough to fill up, though the flavour is ordinary.

d: 肉松卷、草莓抹茶、甜甜圈
i: 悉尼大学公园对面的Cafe，招牌肉松卷很抢手，一早就会卖完，想吃要早点去。草莓抹茶和甜甜圈都普通。
de: Pork floss roll, strawberry matcha, doughnut
ie: Café opposite the University of Sydney park. The signature pork floss roll sells out early, so go early. Strawberry matcha and doughnuts are ordinary.

i: Lane Cove Plaza旁的小甜品店。草莓抹茶抹茶味浓不苦，草莓酸甜中和厚重感，很适合春夏。提拉米苏很软但酒味不足。适合一个人静静坐着发呆。
de: Strawberry matcha, tiramisu
ie: Little dessert shop beside Lane Cove Plaza. Strawberry matcha has strong, non-bitter matcha lifted by tangy strawberry, perfect for spring and summer. The tiramisu is soft but light on liquor. Good for quiet solo time.

i: Top Ryde商场对面低调的上海点心店，现包现煎现煮，开放式厨房干净透明。小馄饨皮薄馅嫩，汤底只放紫菜和虾皮就很鲜；小笼包皮薄汤多，先吸汤再吃，小心烫；锅贴底部金黄酥脆，配店里的辣酱很好吃。值得一去。
de: Small wontons, xiaolongbao, potstickers
ie: Low-key Shanghai dim sum shop opposite Top Ryde shopping centre, made to order in a clean open kitchen. Small wontons with thin skins in a broth of just seaweed and dried shrimp, already very fresh; xiaolongbao with thin skins and lots of soup, sip first and beware the heat; potstickers with golden crisp bottoms, great with their chilli sauce. Worth a visit.

d: 卤煮火烧、千层肉饼、豌豆黄、糖火烧
i: 藏在华人超市里的北京菜，很低调，店里满是京腔。卤煮火烧的肥肠、猪肉和豆腐泡炖得入味不腻，火烧吸满汤汁；千层肉饼外皮酥脆、层次分明、肉香十足。甜品豌豆黄细腻不齁甜，糖火烧外焦里软。人均约25刀。
de: Luzhu huoshao (offal stew with bread), layered meat pie, pea cake, sugar huoshao
ie: Beijing food hidden in a Chinese supermarket, full of Beijing accents. The luzhu huoshao has intestine, pork and tofu puffs stewed rich but not greasy, with bread soaking up the broth; the layered meat pie is crisp and flaky with juicy pork. Pea cake is smooth and not too sweet; sugar huoshao crisp outside, soft inside. About $25 per person.

d: 咸蛋黄贝果、黑芝麻碱水包、芋头酥
i: 从Eastwood开到Chatswood Place的中式烘焙，店面更大。咸蛋黄贝果、黑芝麻碱水包和芋头酥都好吃，芋头酥最值得买。下午货架容易空。
de: Salted egg bagel, black sesame pretzel bun, taro pastry
ie: Chinese bakery from Eastwood, now in a bigger shop at Chatswood Place. Salted egg bagels, black sesame pretzel buns and taro pastry are all good, the taro pastry especially. Shelves empty by afternoon.

d: 滑蛋Hash Brown三明治、韩式热狗
i: Eastwood火车站门口的韩国街头小吃店，卖热狗、炸鸡、三明治和年糕。滑蛋薯饼三明治内容丰富，鸡蛋很嫩；韩式热狗小朋友喜欢。人均约20刀。
de: Scrambled egg hash brown sandwich, Korean hot dog
ie: Korean street food shop by Eastwood station: hot dogs, fried chicken, toast sandwiches and tteokbokki. The scrambled egg hash brown sandwich is loaded and soft; kids like the Korean hot dog. About $20 per person.

i: 和Hokkaido、Uncle Tetsu同类的芝士蛋糕店，爱马仕橙包装很高级。巧克力芝士蛋糕湿润绵密扎实。
de: Chocolate cheesecake
ie: Cheesecake shop in the vein of Hokkaido and Uncle Tetsu, with upmarket Hermès-orange packaging. The chocolate cheesecake is moist, dense and fluffy.

i: 酸奶冰淇淋店，World Square和Chatswood都有，Chatswood店在海底捞对面、Timezone旁。开心果爱好者会喜欢，有开心果味酸奶，可加开心果酱和开心果碎。
de: Pistachio frozen yoghurt
ie: Froyo with stores at World Square and Chatswood (opposite Haidilao, next to Timezone). Pistachio fans will love the pistachio yoghurt with pistachio sauce and crumbs.

i: 实惠的自助火锅，提供7+和牛，虽是冷冻但煮后仍嫩，虾个头大。熟食区中西日韩都有，奶黄流心芝麻球特别好吃。雪糕任吃，可以自己加配料。成人46刀，小孩29刀。
de: MB7+ wagyu, king prawns, sesame balls, ice cream
ie: Good-value hotpot buffet with MB7+ wagyu, frozen but tender once cooked, and big prawns. Hot food spans Chinese, Western, Japanese and Korean; the custard-filled sesame balls are fantastic. Unlimited ice cream with toppings. $46 adults, $29 kids.

d: 豚骨拉面、横滨拉面、蘸面
i: 周末中午要稍微排队的拉面店，表现一般。豚骨拉面和横滨拉面不太咸、浓稠度刚好；蘸面的蘸汤不够浓，面条冰冷。人均约20刀。
de: Tonkotsu ramen, Yokohama ramen, tsukemen
ie: Ramen shop with a small weekend lunch queue, but only average. Tonkotsu and Yokohama ramen are not too salty with good body; the tsukemen dipping broth is thin and the noodles cold. About $20 per person.

i: 火车站步行一分钟的街边小韩国菜馆，店面简陋但很实惠。辣猪骨锅堆成一座小山，十几块猪脊骨炖到一碰就脱骨，配生韭菜很过瘾；海鲜煎饼也不错。份量很大，人均30刀以内。
de: Spicy pork bone stew, seafood pancake
ie: Tiny, rough-and-ready Korean place a minute from the station, but great value. The spicy pork bone stew is a mountain of a dozen spine bones falling off at a touch, great with raw chives; the seafood pancake is good. Huge portions, under $30 per person.

d: 拌鱼生、熏鸭片皮鸭、蒸五花生菜包
i: 开在潮区的韩国餐厅，环境幽暗，菜名看起来难以下手，但味道不错。刺身由服务员桌边拌制，像辣味版的捞起鱼生；片皮鸭用的是熏鸭肉，烟熏味浓；蒸五花肉生菜包的卤肉很香。甜品大麻花普通。人均约50刀，以这个区和环境来说不算贵。
de: Mixed raw fish, smoked duck, steamed pork belly lettuce wraps
ie: Korean restaurant in a hip area, dark and moody, with an intimidating menu that turns out good. Raw fish is tossed tableside like a spicy yusheng; the duck is smoked and very smoky; the steamed pork belly wraps have fragrant braised pork. The giant twisted doughnut dessert is ordinary. About $50 per person, fair for the area and setting.

i: Newtown火车站出口的泰迪熊奶茶店，英伦风装潢有年代感，也有生椰拿铁等流行口味。茉香奶茶普通。
de: Jasmine milk tea
ie: Teddy bear milk tea shop at the Newtown station exit with dated British décor and trendy flavours like fresh coconut latte. The jasmine milk tea is ordinary.

d: Beef Tartare、柠檬烤鸡、美式热狗
i: Surry Hills新Plaza里的西餐厅，早上六点开始营业，有全天菜单。Beef Tartare、柠檬烤鸡和美式热狗都一般，但环境和服务很好。人均约50刀，适合商务谈事，不适合专门来吃饭。
de: Beef tartare, lemon roast chicken, American hot dog
ie: Restaurant in the new Surry Hills plaza, open from 6 am with an all-day menu. Beef tartare, lemon chicken and hot dog are all average, but the setting and service are great. About $50 per person, better for business chats than a dinner out.

d: 紫薯软雪糕、紫薯Biscoff圣代、紫薯抹茶拿铁
i: Marrickville的菲律宾Cafe，甜品都用紫薯Ube制作，满桌紫色。紫薯软雪糕、紫薯Biscoff圣代、紫薯抹茶拿铁和紫薯冰面包都很有特色，紫薯味很像广东的五羊雪糕。
de: Ube soft serve, ube Biscoff sundae, ube matcha latte
ie: Filipino café in Marrickville where every sweet is made with ube, so every table is purple. Ube soft serve, ube Biscoff sundae, ube matcha latte and ube ice bun are all distinctive; ube tastes like Guangdong's Wuyang ice cream.

d: 斑斓椰子、柠檬奶油、香蕉牛奶甜甜圈
i: Cabramatta有名的麻薯甜甜圈，平时在几个地点流动摆摊，周末有时在The Galleries。口感又糯又韧，比普通甜甜圈好吃，口味有斑斓椰子、柠檬奶油、香蕉牛奶等少见款。
de: Pandan coconut, lemon cream, banana milk doughnuts
ie: Famous Cabramatta mochi doughnuts that pop up at various spots, sometimes The Galeries on weekends. Chewy and bouncy, much better than regular doughnuts, with unusual flavours like pandan coconut, lemon cream and banana milk.

d: 香辣猪蹄、香辣鸡爪、冒烤鸭
i: 网评较差的冒菜店，实际没那么难吃。香辣猪蹄和香辣鸡爪软烂入味；冒菜只有咸辣、少了香气；冒烤鸭用整根鸭腿配卤粉，很过瘾。店主是一位女生独力经营。
de: Spicy pig trotters, spicy chicken feet, maocai roast duck
ie: Maocai with poor online reviews, but not that bad. Spicy trotters and chicken feet are soft and well seasoned; the maocai is salty and hot without much aroma; a whole roast duck leg with braised noodles is satisfying. Run single-handedly by its young owner.

i: 开放式厨房的贝果烘焙店，价格实惠，贝果占了大半货架。巧克力贝果配黄油好吃，店员很热情。
de: Chocolate bagel
ie: Bagel bakery with an open kitchen and fair prices; bagels fill most shelves. The chocolate bagel with butter is good, and staff are very friendly.

d: 海南鸡、炸鸡椰浆饭、滑蛋河粉
i: Burwood Rd新开的马来餐厅，开业期间排长队。价格实惠，味道好：海南鸡特别嫩；炸鸡椰浆饭的炸鸡一咬就出汁；滑蛋河粉芡汁浓郁，裹着河粉和海鲜，却不油腻。
de: Hainanese chicken, fried chicken nasi lemak, silky egg hor fun
ie: New Malaysian on Burwood Rd with long opening queues. Cheap and tasty: very tender Hainanese chicken, juicy fried chicken nasi lemak, and silky egg hor fun with rich gravy, seafood and no greasiness.

d: 猪杂血肠汤、炸鸡、芝士玉米
i: Epping少有人知的韩国餐厅，店里干净宽敞。桌上的迷你小虾米和紫苏粉可以自由加；猪杂血肠汤加虾米很好吃，血肠里的粉条有嚼劲。炸鸡嫩脆，可以配芝士玉米吃。人均约25刀。
de: Pork offal and blood sausage soup, fried chicken, corn cheese
ie: Little-known Korean in Epping, clean and spacious. Add tiny shrimp and perilla powder from the table; the pork offal blood sausage soup is great with shrimp, and the glass noodles in the sausage are chewy. Fried chicken is tender and crisp; top it with corn cheese. About $25 per person.

i: 黄色调的可爱小汉堡店，菜单丰富。炸鸡汉堡肉排脆嫩，不错。
de: Fried chicken burger
ie: Cute yellow burger shop with a big menu. The fried chicken burger has a crisp, tender fillet.

i: 新开的铁板汉堡排店，厨师把肉排煎到半熟后放在桌前小铁板上，由客人自己掌握熟度。可以加芝士片和大量芝士丝，很浓郁。桌上有七种调味料，一块肉能吃出七种味道。牛味略重，但很好玩，值得去一次。
te: Hamburg steak on a hot plate
de: Hot plate hamburg steak
ie: New hamburg steak shop: the patty is seared half done and set on a hot plate at your table so you control the doneness. Add cheese slices and a mound of grated cheese. Seven condiments give seven flavours. A bit beefy in taste, but fun and worth one visit.

i: 华人区新开的连锁日式拉面店，下单时可以调整辣度、面条软硬、配菜和油量。汤头浓郁，面条软硬适中，作为普通拉面可以，不必专程。
de: Customisable ramen
ie: New ramen chain in a Chinese neighbourhood where you can adjust spice, noodle firmness, toppings and oil. Rich broth and well-cooked noodles; fine as everyday ramen, not a destination.

d: 鱼生配海胆、炸大虾、辣蟹汤（38刀三只蟹）
i: Eastwood的韩式鱼生店，纯鱼生不腌制，有三种鱼和海胆，蘸辣蒜蓉豆瓣酱，有点潮州鱼生的风味。炸大虾比手掌还大，香脆必点。最推荐辣蟹汤，38刀有3只螃蟹，用料十足，汤拌饭非常好吃。人均约47刀。
de: Raw fish with uni, giant fried prawns, spicy crab stew ($38 with three crabs)
ie: Korean raw fish in Eastwood, unmarinated, three fish plus uni, dipped in spicy garlic bean paste with a hint of Teochew raw fish. Fried prawns bigger than your palm are a must. The star is the spicy crab stew, $38 with three crabs, superb over rice. About $47 per person.

i: Gordon的自助酸奶冰淇淋店，可以自己装酸奶、加配料，小朋友很喜欢。人均约8刀。
de: Self-serve frozen yoghurt
ie: Self-serve froyo in Gordon where you pour your own and add toppings; kids love it. About $8 per person.

d: 紫菜Cracker、黑松露萝卜糕、盐酥鸡、虾多士
i: Macquarie Park新楼盘下的台湾融合菜。紫菜脆片、黑松露萝卜糕、盐酥鸡和虾多士都好吃，虾多士又脆又香，虾个头大。人均约40刀，不便宜，附近可以来尝鲜，不必专程。
de: Seaweed crackers, black truffle radish cake, popcorn chicken, prawn toast
ie: Taiwanese fusion under new apartments in Macquarie Park. Seaweed crackers, truffle radish cake, popcorn chicken and prawn toast are all good; the prawn toast is crisp with big prawns. About $40 per person, not cheap; worth trying if nearby.
